calendarSync.title: Calendar sync
calendarSync.text: Your bookings in the calendar on your phone or computer. New ones, moves and cancellations show up by themselves.
calendarSync.offText: Get a private link your calendar app subscribes to: Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook.
calendarSync.appleHint: iPhone, iPad, Mac: tap, then Subscribe
calendarSync.googleHint: Adds it to your Google account and the Google Calendar app. Google checks for changes every few hours
calendarSync.googleStepsHint: Set it up once on a computer: tap for the steps
calendarSync.googleStep1: Copy the link below and send it to yourself.
calendarSync.googleStep3: Next to “Other calendars”, choose + → From URL, paste the link and add it.
calendarSync.googleStepsAfter: It then shows in the Google Calendar app on this phone. Google checks for changes every few hours.
calendarSync.copyHint: For any other calendar: “Subscribe by URL”
calendarSync.private: This link shows your bookings, with clients' names, to anyone who has it. Keep it to yourself; if it gets out, get a new one.
calendarSync.resetText: The old link stops working at once: calendars subscribed to it stop updating. Subscribe again with the new one.
calendarSync.resetDone: New link ready. Subscribe again with it
calendarSync.offText2: The link stops working: subscribed calendars keep what they have but get no more updates.
calendarSync.instantText: Connect your calendar and every booking shows up in it within seconds: new ones, moves, confirmations and cancellations.
calendarSync.googleInstantHint: Adds a calendar just for your bookings to your Google account

calendarSync.connectedHint: Your bookings show up there as they change
calendarSync.googleReconnectHint: Google stopped letting the app write to your calendar. Connect again and it catches up.
calendarSync.appleReconnectHint: iCloud stopped accepting the app-specific password. Connect again with a new one.
calendarSync.syncStarted: Syncing: your calendar catches up within a minute
calendarSync.googleConnected: Google Calendar connected. Your bookings are on their way

calendarSync.appleConnected: Apple Calendar connected. Your bookings are on their way
calendarSync.disconnectGoogleText: The app's calendar, with the bookings in it, is removed from your Google account. Your other calendars stay as they are.
calendarSync.disconnectAppleText: The app's calendar, with the bookings in it, is removed from iCloud. Your other calendars stay as they are.
calendarSync.appleText: Your bookings go into a calendar of their own in iCloud, on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.
calendarSync.appleStep1: Open <site>account.apple.com</site> and sign in with your Apple ID.
calendarSync.appleStep2: Choose Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords.
calendarSync.appleStep3: Add one named “Nails by Alynna”, copy the password and paste it below.
calendarSync.applePasswordHint: Not your Apple ID password. Kept encrypted and used only to add your bookings to the calendar.

scheduling.text: Which times clients are offered online, so each master's day stays full.
